en: After parading Mordecai, which body part did Haman cover hurrying home?
Whom did Queen Esther set over the house of Haman?
After Mordecai's decree, what fell on many peoples, so they became Jews?
On which day of the month was Mordecai's decree written?
When the Jews killed Haman's sons and their enemies, what did they not take?
In Mordecai's dream, which creatures represented him and Haman?
In Mordecai's dream, Esther was a little spring that became what?
